1903befb.text: After the Scythe was freed, They came at us from everywhere, clawing from hidden holes at our feet and dropping upon us from silent perches above.  Half our men fell in those first panicked minutes.  The rest, including myself, tried to flee.  As I ran I saw so many of my brothers taken by tooth and claw, heard so many screams cut short or gurgle to silence.
1903befb.title: Book from Sven's Farm

1ed64c09.text: <The rest of the book is blank>
1ed64c09.title: Book from Sven's Farm

2de336e4.text:
Blacknails--

The Sea awaits us.  We need your supplies from the North.  Strip everything: every railroad pike, every waterbucket.  We need metal.  A shipment is due from BB but long overdue.  Come through for me, Blacknails.  Send your supplies directly to the "barn" this time.  No time to squander.

--VanCleef
2de336e4.title: A Mysterious Message

35a4a4e3.text: The terror of these past few weeks is almost more than I can bear; yet, I feel that by writing down that which I've seen I will somehow be comforted.  So I do it, and it is the only comfort I have these bleak days.
35a4a4e3.title: Book from Sven's Farm

44973cc4.text:
After surviving the flight from Roland's Doom, I hid within a barn owned by a man named Sven.  I spent a few days in the barn, and such horror lingered with me that I never once made myself known to Sven or his family.  But from what I saw from my hiding place, I knew these farmers were quite decent folk.  Had I stepped from my concealment I think they would have taken me in, but trust is hard for me.  Harder still after that shock in the mine.

So I remained hidden.
44973cc4.title: Book from Sven's Farm

9f033b7c.text:
Your Honor--

All of Westfall mourns for your loss,  but we are plagued with our own war in Westfall.  The farmers have been run off by thieves and mechanical golems.  Stormwind withdrew its troops, leaving the people defenseless.  I mustered the People's Militia in the wake of Stormwind's abandonment to save what remains of this land.  To take the Militia to Redridge would mean certain doom for Westfall.

My regrets,
Gryan Stoutmantle
9f033b7c.title: Stoutmantle's Response to Solomon

b9c35edd.text:
Your Honor--

I regret to inform you that the Night Watch is unable to leave its post in Darkshire at this time.  Perhaps you were unaware that Stormwind no longer provides military support in this region.  The Night Watch has been formed and trained entirely by the people of the forest in order to defend Darkshire in Stormwind's absence.  Without the Watch, the town would fall.  I wish you luck with your plight.

--Lord Ello Ebonlocke
b9c35edd.title: Ebonlocke's Response to Solomon

bbc330d4.text:
I can only guess why I survived that night.  I have always been cautious, always quick to flinch from jabs and leap free of pitfalls.  My nickname comes from this trait.  So perhaps it was just that knack for caution that saved me...

Or maybe it was the Scythe I pulled from the rubble.  It cannot be the Scythe itself, for I lost it during my frantic flight.  But if it was I who brought the Worgen to Duskwood, then perhaps the Worgen afforded me a rare courtesy.  Curse them.
bbc330d4.title: Book from Sven's Farm

d991212d.text:
It began with the finding of that cursed scythe in Roland's Doom.  Before the Scythe, the terrors of this place seemed as tame as Northshire Valley.

But ever since I found the haft of the Scythe jutting from that pile of rubble in the mine and, curse me, pulled it free, Roland's Doom became a place of vile death!
d991212d.title: Book from Sven's Farm

234|eba492ed.name: Gryan Stoutmantle
234|eba492ed.text: A foul corruption has crept into Westfall.  While I was upholding my duty on the battlefields of Lordaeron these honest farms were overrun and made into hide-outs for thugs and murderers. The People's Militia needs your help.

258568|ed056522.name: Antonio Bolero
258568|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

265|94d9e780.name: Madame Eva
265|94d9e780.text: I have sensed your coming for quite some time, $N.  It was written in the pattern of the stars.

277|ed056522.name: Roberto Pupellyverbos
277|ed056522.text: Best deals in all of Stormwind my friend, won't find any better. Now, what can I help you with?

341|5d781570.name: Foreman Oslow
341|5d781570.text: I don't have much time for idle talk, ANAKIN.  I've got to get this bridge rebuilt before the rains come.  I've finished every project on-time and under budget and I'm not about to start slipping now.

344|d18fd3a5.name: Magistrate Solomon
344|d18fd3a5.text: Who is this $c who goes before the Court of Lakshire in the Kingdom of Stormwind?  State your business within this township, $R.  The orc threat to the Kingdom is far too great to squander time in idle conversation.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

352|c23f1156.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|c23f1156.text: These great beasts know paths that ye can't find on foot, they'll get ye there fast and maybe show ye something new at the same time.

382|04802d87.name: Marshal Marris
382|04802d87.text: I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.

415|fca64b70.name: Verner Osgood
415|fca64b70.text: Hey buddy, do you think you could give me a hand with something?  I'm really in dire straits here...

5694|f9a7a324.name: High Sorcerer Andromath
5694|f9a7a324.text: The flow of magic is unpredictable and chaotic, of late. What, I wonder, could be the cause of this?

6727|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Brianna
6727|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

8931|c80041d2.name: Innkeeper Heather
8931|c80041d2.text: Welcome to my Inn, weary traveler. What can I do for you?

927|837f02f9.name: Brother Wilhelm
927|837f02f9.text: May the Light protect you this day.

101-progress.name: Madame Eva
101-progress.text: Bring to me 10 ghoul fangs, 10 skeleton fingers and 5 vials of spider venom.  For you I shall enchant a Totem of Infliction which will harm those who attempt violent acts against you.
101-progress.title: The Totem of Infliction

119-progress.text: Great, you're back!  Did you get the shoes?

121-progress.title: Messenger to Stormwind

141-progress.text: Did Master Shaw shed any light on things?

142-progress.text: $N, were you able to gather any information?  Did you locate the messenger?
142-progress.title: The Defias Brotherhood

145-progress.title: Messenger to Darkshire

214-progress.title: Red Silk Bandanas

7791-progress.name: Clavicus Knavingham
7791-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7791-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

79092-progress.title: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal

98387-progress.name: Marshal Marris
98387-progress.text: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
98387-progress.title: Blackrock Blockade
